# Ana Beatriz Silva

> Data Analyst based in Ireland. SQL, Python, and BI dashboards — turning raw data into decisions teams can act on.

## About

Personal website of Ana Beatriz Silva, Data Analyst. Covers data analysis, reporting, data visualisation, and hands-on
data projects. Based in Ireland and open to roles nationwide.

## Sections

- [Home](https://www.anabsilva.com/): About, areas of expertise, and certifications.
- [Portfolio](https://www.anabsilva.com/portfolio/): Data projects with code, descriptions, and screenshots.
- [Blog](https://www.anabsilva.com/blog/): Notes on data analysis, tooling, and lessons learned.

## Areas of expertise

- Data analysis and reporting (SQL, Excel, KPIs)
- Dashboards and data visualisation (Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio)
- Python and data wrangling (pandas, Jupyter, data cleaning)
- Databases and data quality (PostgreSQL, MySQL, data modelling, ETL)
